claim: Patchline generates ready-to-claim starter issues directly from structured roadmap cards, so every good-first-issue is concrete, reproducible, and tied to a gate from the moment it is filed. Each roadmap card declares a title, the failure mode the work prevents, the expected gate the contributor must make pass, and the artifact path where the generated evidence lands; the worker renders a complete issue with context, acceptance criteria, and a reproduce command for each card. The gate proves every generated issue carries all four structured fields, a valid gate target name, and an artifact path under results/generated.
real_repo: patchline (self): roadmap cards rendered into starter issues

cards.title: Add Redis change detection coverage for a sixth real repository
cards.failure_mode: Destructive Redis FLUSHDB/DEL operations slip through review unflagged.

cards.title: Extend the data-pipeline detector to a new Flink job pattern
cards.failure_mode: A Flink overwrite sink is not recognized as a destructive pipeline change.

cards.title: Add a protobuf cross-version field-number reuse check
cards.failure_mode: A reused protobuf field number across versions breaks wire compatibility silently.
